title: Con đường về
about: Round 26, ke-chuyen ("làm luôn 7 bài cho đủ album"): B minor in 3/4 at 70 bpm, footsteps home. Its motif walks up three steps (D-E-F#) and leaps a sixth (to D6), then steps down again; its answer walks up from C# and leaps to C#6. The climax is kept for late in the piece, the leap widened to an octave (D5-D6) and the tune reaching E6. The arc: the piano alone; the cellos' slow second line; the walk going on in D major with the violas' thin line added; the climax with the strings and the piano's rolled chords; home with the violas only at the sentences' ends; the walk once more, its leap landing on B. An original tune.
